description: This Java source file defines the class UnitsComboBoxEditor, which provides a custom cell editor for a JTable component. Specifically, it allows selecting and editing units or conversion options via a JComboBox for data represented by LoggerData objects within a GUI, enabling user interaction for converting ECU-related data.

classes.name: UnitsComboBoxEditor
classes.description: A custom table cell editor for selecting ECU data conversion units using a JComboBox within a JTable. Implements user interaction to choose and update conversion data for ECU logging.

methods.name: getCellEditorValue
methods.description: Returns the currently selected conversion object from the LoggerData associated with the cell.

methods.name: getTableCellEditorComponent
methods.description: Creates and initializes a JComboBox populated with the available converters and returns it as the cell editor component.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles user actions on the JComboBox; when an item is selected, updates the LoggerData with the chosen converter and signals that editing has stopped.
